check_interval_minutes.description: Metric alerts only: evaluation cadence in minutes, at least 15.

cooldown_minutes.description: Metric alerts only: minimum minutes between repeated notifications. 0 means no cooldown.

datapoints_to_alarm.description: Metric alerts only: how many periods must breach to fire (N in N-of-M).

direction.description:
Metric alerts only: whether the alert fires at or above, or at or below, the threshold.

* `above` - At or above
* `below` - At or below

enabled.description: Whether the alert is active. Disabling a metric alert resets its state to not_firing.

evaluation_periods.description: Metric alerts only: total check periods in the sliding evaluation window (M in N-of-M).

kind.description:
'metric' fires when a metric crosses a threshold over a rolling window; 'match' fires on every observation that matches the selection. Immutable after creation.

* `metric` - Metric
* `match` - Match

metric.description:
Metric alerts only: what to measure over the window. 'avg_score' requires a scorer scanner.

* `count` - Count matching observations
* `avg_score` - Average score

name.description: Human-readable name for this alert. Defaults to 'Untitled alert' on create when omitted.

scanner_id.description: Scanner whose observations this alert watches. Immutable after creation.

blocked_windows.description: Blocked local time windows when the alert must not run. Overlapping or identical windows are merged when saved. At most five windows before normalization; empty array clears quiet hours.

end.description: End time HH:MM (24-hour). Exclusive (half-open interval). Each window must span ≥ 30 minutes locally.

start.description: Start time HH:MM (24-hour, project timezone). Inclusive. Each window must span ≥ 30 minutes on the local daily timeline (half-open [start, end)).

schedule_restriction.description: Blocked local time windows when the alert must not notify. Times use the project timezone. Null disables quiet hours.

selection.description: Which observations count. Empty matches every observation of the scanner.

tags.description: Classifier tags to match; an observation matches when it carries any of them.

snooze_until.description: ISO 8601 timestamp until which the alert is snoozed. Set to null to unsnooze.

threshold.description: Metric alerts only: the threshold value. Required for metric alerts, must be omitted for match alerts.

window_days.description: Metric alerts only: rolling window in days. Allowed values: [1, 3, 7, 14, 30].
